notes: 12 icons generated by one isometric engine (true 30° projection, 9 three-tone ramps, 2px ink stroke, 128x128). Grid page with per-icon/all/sprite download, copy, inspector dialog, 30° grid overlay, dark mode. v2 also ships 12 standalone files in v2/icons/.
v1_issues: Grid overlay not clipped (svg overflow:visible), so the lines covered the whole page and other cards; an empty toast pill was visible; on mobile the 2-column grid overflowed horizontally and the size switcher stayed on 160 while the icons rendered at 120; the softbox was a flat panel with weak depth; the tripod's front leg overlapped the centre column; the hard-drive platter arm looked like a keyhole; the separate SVGs existed only as blob downloads.
v2_changes: Clip the grid to the 128 frame; hide the toast properly; mobile layout uses minmax(0,1fr), meta stacks and the default size follows the screen width; staggered card entrance plus reduced-motion support; deeper softbox with rim thickness, seams, highlight and speedring; tripod legs placed at 15/135/255 degrees and depth-sorted; hard-drive arm with pivot and status LED; 12 separate files exported to v2/icons/*.svg (valid XML) and linked from each card.
